It is held flat to it. ratio = genomic level at its young end / anchor, before scaling; flagged when beyond 10x either way; factor = 1 / ratio, except on a flagged join whose young end is below the median of its resolved steps (ToLaD#172, `meet` median): that median meets the anchor instead (factor = anchor / res_median_raw) and the young steps it puts below the anchor are held at it (`held`), so the deep past peaks at most res_max_raw / res_median_raw above the anchor; not where [deep.blind] cites the young end's decline (the lion). red_list_extinct_flags.note: Open Tree leaves no other source marks extinct that the IUCN Red List 2026-1 assesses EX (ToLaD#105)

stem_rehoming.rule: fossil-only subtrees older than the Upham 95% HPD upper bound of an enclosing crown node are moved to that crown's stem (inside a total-group node)

unrecognised_tips.note: living Open Tree tips no extant-species list recognises (Upham, PHYLACINE, IUCN Red List, Greenspoon/IUCN census and model tables, domestic tables), dropped (ToLaD#116): subspecies, stale spellings, synonyms and unflagged fossils of species the tree already counts

unverified_extant_tips.note: living Open Tree tips that only the IUCN Red List 2026-1 (or a domestic table) recognises, not Upham, PHYLACINE or Greenspoon/IUCN: mostly recent splits. Their counts come from the occupancy model only. Tips no list recognises are dropped (ToLaD#116, stats.json -> unrecognised_tips).
